summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by removing fully qualified field names in the generated SQL for CheckConstraints, but it may not handle all edge cases and could introduce behavioral regressions.

issues.description: The patch only removes fully qualified field names by replacing them with an empty string, which might not cover all edge cases or different SQL dialects.
The change could potentially break existing behavior if there are other parts of the codebase that rely on fully qualified field names in constraints.
